decisions.reason: The winner-count decision does not invalidate the FAQ's existing general description of Chainlink VRF selection, and the same-message FAQ update already captures the expressly requested beginner guidance.
The Small Block mechanism already specifies one winner per draw from message 158; message 210 reiterates that value without changing its state.
Changing or reiterating the number of winners does not alter automatic prize transfer, announcement locations, or winner notifications.
The candidate's existing message-210 Event already states that one affiliate is selected from each 100-sales block, so no additional or edited Event is required.
Winner count does not change the prize pool's funding sources, per-mint allocation, duration, or active pool.
Selecting one winner does not change ticket counters, eligibility windows, post-draw reset behavior, or the existing ticket-weighting rule.
The winner-count decision does not alter the no-referral trigger, random reward recipient, commission amount, or Small Block ticket award.
Winner count has no necessary effect on hero placement, layout elements, or book-cover imagery.
The existing message-210 Event already captures the hero's one-entry giveaway wording; the number of selected winners does not require an additional hero-message state change.
Winner count does not change the requirement to display earned commissions and prize tickets in the dashboard.
Selecting one winner per draw does not alter the $15 mint price or the founder, affiliate, and prize-pool allocation.
Winner count is unrelated to the book cover's landing-page placement.
